--- /linux/fs/namei.c
+++ /linux/fs/namei.c
@@ -5219,0 +5220,8 @@
+	/*
+	 * On a corrupted filesystem, the victim might be the parent directory
+	 * itself (i.e. a hardlink to the directory). This would cause a
+	 * deadlock if we try to lock the directory again.
+	 */
+	if (dentry->d_inode == dir)
+		return -EINVAL;
+
